claims.text: Clinician documented penicillin allergy with widespread rash in 2019.

citations.quote: Allergic to penicillin; widespread rash in 2019.

open_questions: When was the penicillin allergy first recorded, and what was the nature and timing of the rash reaction?
Was the penicillin allergy ever re-evaluated, challenged, or de-labelled after 2019?
What evidence supports the clinician instruction to 'write that all allergies are resolved' — was there testing, documentation of resolution, or a formal allergy review?
What medications were prescribed, administered, or avoided due to the penicillin allergy, and when were those decisions made?
Is there any record of an allergy action plan, patient education, or allergy alert removal from the record?
What other allergies or adverse drug reactions are documented besides penicillin?

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: The clinician instruction requests stating 'all allergies are resolved', but no record evidence confirms resolution of the documented penicillin allergy.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Verify whether penicillin allergy has been formally re-evaluated or de-labelled before updating allergy status.
